title: Operator Rate Sculptor — Preset Chains, Emergency Holds, and Provenance Timeline
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
This ticket scopes the Console UI feature 'Operator Rate Sculptor' — a set of fine-grained fleet controls for Dedicated capacity customers that lets operators create chained scaling presets, place emergency holds (throttle/freeze), and inspect a provenance timeline for every control change. The goal is to provide deterministic throughput guarantees while giving SRE/operators clear rollback and auditability instruments.

Problem statement:
- Operators currently lack a single surfaced workflow to create repeatable scaling presets and to temporarily throttle fleets during incidents.
- Change history is fragmented across infra logs and audit tables; Console needs an integrated provenance timeline with context (who, why, linked runbooks/PRs).

This ticket covers UX flows, acceptance criteria, and a phased rollout with toggles for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Create/Save/Delete scaling preset (name, min/max GPUs, burst policy, target RPS) from Fleet Controls UI and persist in config store
Apply a preset to one or more fleet groups with preview of expected throughput and estimated cost delta
Place 'Emergency Hold' that immediately drops new allocations and surfaces expected latency degradation with confirm modal
Provenance timeline shows chronological changes (preset applied, hold placed, manual scale) with actor, timestamp, rationale, and linked artifacts
All actions surface a lightweight 'undo' for 10 minutes and generate corresponding audit events consumed by backend auditing pipeline
RBAC: only users with operator role can create presets or place holds; read-only roles can view timeline and metrics
End-to-end e2e test covering preset application, emergency hold, and timeline entries
engineering_notes: Backend: new /fleet-presets REST endpoints; store in config-db with versioned changelog
Runtime: preset application triggers a reconciliation job that updates autoscaler policies; must be idempotent
Telemetry: emit event.type=fleet.preset.apply with metadata:preset_id, fleet_id, actor, correlation_id
Performance: preview calculation should use recent 5m p95 throughput profile; precompute on fetch for UX responsiveness
Integration: audit events must be bubbled to Private deployment audit log sink (Kinesis/Log-collector)
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal dogfood behind feature flag for Redwood SRE (2 weeks). Phase 2: limited beta to 3 enterprise accounts with dedicated capacity (4 weeks). Phase 3: general availability with console-2026.04 release. Feature flag gates for Emergency Hold and Undo.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Emergency Hold could accidentally reduce capacity for high-priority customers — Mitigation: require dual-approval for holds affecting >50% fleet capacity
Risk: Preset application causes cascading autoscaler oscillation — Mitigation: add rate-limit and cooldown enforcement in autoscaler reconciliation
Risk: Audit events delayed in heavy traffic — Mitigation: write audit to transactional store first, then async fan-out
